Apple (AAPL) Holder Ims Capital Management Lifted Stake; Westport Asset Management Holding in Check Point Software Technolog (CHKP) Boosted as Valuation Declined
April 29, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Westport Asset Management Inc increased its stake in Check Point Software Technolog (CHKP) by 34.68% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Westport Asset Management Inc bought 6,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.77% with the market. The institutional investor held 23,300 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.54 million, up from 17,300 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Westport Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Check Point Software Technolog for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $15.65B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.80% or $1.75 during the last trading session, reaching $95.73. About 1.39 million shares traded. Check Point Software Technologies Ltd. (NASDAQ:CHKP) has declined 4.45% since April 29, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 16.00% the S&P500.
Ims Capital Management increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 17.55% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ims Capital Management bought 2,475 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 16,580 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.81M, up from 14,105 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ims Capital Management who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $823.61B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.16% or $1.9 during the last trading session, reaching $162.32. About 35.66M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.

The rating was maintained by BMO Capital Markets with “Hold” on Friday, July 14. The rating was maintained by Northland Capital on Thursday, September 28 with “Hold”. Oppenheimer maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Wednesday, June 28 report. The stock of Check Point Software Technologies Ltd. (NASDAQ:CHKP) earned “Neutral” rating by UBS on Thursday, April 26. The stock of Check Point Software Technologies Ltd. (NASDAQ:CHKP) earned “Hold” rating by BMO Capital Markets on Thursday, August 31. The stock of Check Point Software Technologies Ltd. (NASDAQ:CHKP) has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, October 19 by Jefferies. The stock has “Neutral” rating by Citigroup on Friday, July 21.
